claims.text: [simulation_measurement] The committed acceptance run executes the seeded scheduler at 3 deterministic seeds (1201, 3407, 5527) x 1,000,000 simulated operations each and reports 0 violations of INV1-INV6 and SAF in the resulting traces.
[safety] Injecting a crash after local transition but before publish yields exactly one local effect receipt per effect and no duplicate effect once the outbox is replayed.

[safety] Unknown external outcomes enter reconciliation and are never blind-retried: the effect is recorded as delivered exactly once and any later idempotent replay of the same key refuses re-execution.
[invariant] INV1 (only a gate can accept a goal, and only over an evaluator record) holds across all simulated steps; worker/tool acceptance paths are refused.

[safety] INV2 (scope), INV3 (attenuation and policy immutability), INV4 (promotion evidence), INV5 (revocation monotonicity), INV6 (budget conservation), and SAF (atomic transition+audit, effect exactly-once) hold with zero violations in the reported traces.

[design_obligation] Every liveness claim (LIVE) either has a publish/outbox trace in the simulation or is explicitly labelled a design obligation to be discharged by the implementation, not the bounded simulation.

[design_obligation] The bounded simulation is acceptance evidence, not a proof of arbitrary LLM behavior or production distributed consensus; unbounded state spaces are out of scope and escalate instead of overclaiming.

[failure_mode] Deterministic fault injection covers the enumerated failure modes (crash before publish, unknown outcome, stale fence, orphan promotion, over-allocation, cross-scope read, approval replay); all attempts are denied by guards and none become violations.

[simulation_measurement] The simulation is deterministic stdlib-only Python: the same seed and op count reproduce byte-identical counters and verdicts; the auditor can reproduce the seed/configuration from the committed script.

[design_obligation] Formal methods (TLA+/Alloy) can express the invariant set and the safety/liveness distinction used here; translation into a checker is a design obligation rather than acceptance evidence in this ticket.

research_plan.content:
# Research Plan - S1-004 Alloy/TLA+ and seeded deterministic invariant simulation

## Question
Can bounded TLA+/Alloy-style models and a seeded scheduler exercise INV1-INV6,
outbox delivery, fencing, effect receipts, reconciliation, and crash recovery
without a safety violation?

## Approach
Deterministic stdlib-only Python simulation (`invariant_simulation.py`) of the
AgentOS envelope, following the small-scope/bounded-model hypothesis of
Alloy/TLA+ rather than claiming an unbounded proof. The model encodes the
agent lifecycle, tool gateway, outbox, fencing epochs, one-time exact-action
approvals, budget reservation, memory scoping, delegation attenuation,
promotion-evidence gate, and the audit journal.

## Acceptance envelope
- 3 deterministic seeds (1201, 3407, 5527); 1,000,000 simulated operations per
  seed per acceptance run.
- Properties: INV1 (gate-only ACCEPTED), INV2 (memory scope), INV3 (attenuation
  /policy immutability), INV4 (promotion evidence), INV5 (revocation
  monotonicity), INV6 (budget conservation), SAF (atomic transition+audit;
  effect exactly-once at the sink; unique receipts).
- Fault injection: crash-after-local-transition-before-publish (CRASH-A),
  unknown-external-outcome (CRASH-B), stale fence, orphan promotion,
  over-allocation, approval replay, cross-scope read, untrusted content.
- Verdict: 0 violations of INV1-INV6/SAF across all traces; every LIVE claim
  has a trace or is labelled a design obligation.

## Review-fixed semantics (2026-08-31)
Two fail-open model bugs were found and fixed during authoring: CRASH-B effects
stayed in the outbox (later replay executed the sink twice -> spurious SAF
duplicate), and unknown-outcome effects were never receipted at end-of-seed.
Now CRASH-B = sink executed exactly once + single receipt + reconciliation,
never replay.

feature_catalog.content:
# Feature catalog - S1-004 (simulation envelope features)

- Seeded scheduler: deterministic RNG per seed; lifecycle op mix.
- Tool gateway: capability checks, one-time approvals, fencing, idempotent replay.
- Outbox: crash-A entries replayed exactly once; crash-B resolved via reconciliation.
- Budget: reservation/spend/release/revoke with INV6 guards (over-allocation denied).
- Memory: scoped writes/reads; cross-scope denied (INV2).
- Delegation: child caps attenuated subset of parent (INV3).
- Promotion gate: promoted assertions require evidence (INV4).
- Revocation: monotone revocation; post-revoke denied (INV5).
- Journal: transition+audit atomic commit (SAF); gate-only accept (INV1).

architecture_models.content:
# Architecture models - S1-004

State-flow: Concept -> Specification -> Plan -> Execution -> Verification ->
Accepted Artifact + Evidence Pack (gate-only acceptance).

Simulation model: runs (workers) with caps + fencing epoch; effects ->
outbox -> publish/sink/receipt; unknown outcomes -> reconciliation; audit
journal (transition+event atomic). CRASH-A and CRASH-B injected at the
publish boundary. Formal-property map: INV1..INV6/SAF formalized as post-hoc
checks over observable state each step plus drain-time closure checks (see
mathematical_model). Preserves the gateway-only-effects and atomic
transition/audit boundary from S1-005.

mental_model.content:
# Mental model - S1-004

An outer envelope delegates an intent to an inner worker agent with attenuated
capabilities. Every external effect is a deliverable: either published
(receipt issued once) or unknown-outcome (receiver executed but unconfirmed ->
reconciliation, never blind retry). Crashes split delivery into local-commit
vs publish; recovery replays only the undelivered (CRASH-A) subset. Budget,
scope, and delegation stay monotone and attenuated; the gate is the only
entity that can accept a goal.

ontology.content:
# Ontology - S1-004

- Goal(concept, constraints, risk_tier, status in {DRAFT, PLANNED, RUNNING,
  VERIFIED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED}); ACCEPTED only via gate record (INV1).
- Run(worker_type, lease, epoch, caps, crashed).
- Effect(id, kind, status in {PENDING_DELIVERY, PUBLISHED, UNKNOWN,
  RECONCILED}); unique receipts per effect (SAF).
- Approval(nonce, actor, operation, canonical_args, expiry) consumed exactly once.
- Grant/revocation (INV5): monotone; post-revoke allow denied.
- Assertion (INV4): promotion requires evidence + independence.
- Memory record (provenance, scope); cross-scope reads denied (INV2).

Aligned with S1-003 shapes and the S1-005 gateway-only-effects boundary.

mathematical_model.content:
# Mathematical model - S1-004

- INV1: ACCEPTED(goal) => gate_record(eval) exists; accept_actor == gate.
- INV2: read(m) in scope(s) => s within owner-scope(m).
- INV3: policy_caps invariant; child_caps subset of parent_caps.
- INV4: promoted(a) => evidence(a) AND independence(a).
- INV5: revoked(g) monotone; post-revoke allow(g) is a violation.
- INV6: spent + reserved <= budget; reserved == sum(reservations).
- SAF: journal_tx == audit_events (atomic); sink_executed(e) == 1;
  receipts == published; unknown outcomes never re-executed.
- LIVE: each liveness claim has a trace or an explicit design-obligation label.

Simulation: 3 seeds x 1,000,000 ops; same seed => byte-identical counters.

synthesis_and_gaps.content:
# Synthesis and gaps - S1-004

Synthesis: the seeded simulation envelope covers the ticket scope (identity
separation, single scope, attenuation, no orphan promotion, revocation
monotonicity, budget conservation, outbox/replay, unknown-outcome
reconciliation, deterministic fault injection) with 0 violations in the
acceptance runs and all failure-mode attempts denied by guards.

Gaps (design obligations): production distributed consensus, unbounded model
checking, model->implementation translation into TLA+/Alloy checkers, live
LLM behavior. Runtime measurement awaits the S1-005 topology decision and the
S1-002 benchmark baseline.

independent_audit.content:
# Independent audit - S1-004

Auditor: agentos-s1-004-independent-verifier (process-separated, adversarial).

Checks performed: reproduced seeds/configuration; re-ran the simulation at
3 seeds x 1,000,000 ops; confirmed 0 violations; confirmed CRASH-A replay
produces exactly one receipt and no duplicate; confirmed CRASH-B enters
reconciliation without blind retry; confirmed failure-mode guards deny every
attempted attack. During review, two fail-open model bugs were found and their
fixes verified (2026-08-31).

Verdict: pass_with_limits - bounded trace is not a proof; model and
implementation must keep in agreement on ownership/budget semantics.

Limitations: auditor is process-separated within one local environment, not an
external human; formal translations into TLA+/Alloy remain obligations.

platform_plan.content:
# Platform plan - S1-004

# Scope
Adopt the seeded deterministic simulation as the acceptance envelope for
INV1-INV6/SAF in CI (fixed seeds, bounded probe, full 1M acceptance run as a
committed artifact). No production containers or new trust boundaries are
introduced by this ticket.

# Architecture
The simulation models only the declared runtime semantics: gateway-only
effects, single policy-state owner, atomic transition+audit, outbox/replay,
reconciliation, fencing, budgets. It is a research artifact, not released
software; it runs as a probe in the research-plan pipeline and in CI as a
regression layer.

# Workstreams
1. Model: keep invariant_simulation.py in sync with spec/SPEC.md sematics.
2. Probes: bounded CI probe (fast) + committed full 1M acceptance run.
3. Integration: wire the probe into research-plan probes block and CI gate.

# Milestones
- M1 (this ticket): simulation + probes + bundle PASS_WITH_LIMITS.
- M2: production reliability measurement exists (S1-005 topology + S1-002
  bench) -> embed simulation as regression layer.
- M3: formal translation into TLA+/Alloy checker (design obligation).

# Verification
- Bounded probe: 3 seeds x 200,000 ops, 0 violations, exit 0.
- Acceptance run: 3 seeds x 1,000,000 ops, 0 violations (committed JSON).
- Focused probes: crash-before-publish-replay -> receipts == effects, no
  duplicates; unknown-outcome -> reconciliation, never blind retry.

# Risks
- Model/implementation contract drift on ownership/budget semantics
  (escalation if counterexample cannot be reduced to a deterministic trace).
- Bounded trace overclaimed as proof (mitigated: explicit non-goals).

# Open decisions
- Exact TLA+/Alloy checker and its CI placement (deferred, design obligation).
- Whether liveness traces require a longer acceptance horizon than 1M ops.
